trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through an opening large enough for a Medium creature. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) Necrotic damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Necrotic damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}.
